title: Authority Grant
description: The Authority state variable, modeled as a lease on consequential action: which actions a grantee is currently permitted to perform, for whom, on what evidence, and until when. A grant is an explicit state transition, never a side effect of capability (Law I). It decays unless its justification is renewed (Law II) and becomes eligible for reconsideration when its evidence basis changes (Law III). Expansion of scope is a new authorization decision recorded in state_history (Law XI).

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the grant conforms to.

grant_id.title: Grant identifier
grant_id.description: Stable identifier for the grant, referenced by decision records, challenges, and reconsiderations.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Who issued the grant, when, and the summary of the basis on which it was issued.

issued_by.title: Issued by
issued_by.description: Identifier of the person or body that issued the grant.

basis_summary.title: Basis summary
basis_summary.description: Plain-language summary of why this delegation was justified at issue time.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: The boundary of the lease: which action classes, on which systems, over which populations, within which limits.

action_classes.title: Scoped action classes
action_classes.description: Action classes the grant covers, matching the catalog's action_class values.

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: Systems or resources the grantee may act on under this grant.

populations.title: Populations
populations.description: Populations of subjects the grantee may act upon.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Quantitative or qualitative limits on the lease, such as rate, value, or duration caps, keyed by limit name.

issuing_authority.title: Issuing authority
issuing_authority.description: The accountable owner of the grant who can be reached to renew, narrow, or revoke it.

grantee.title: Grantee
grantee.description: The component that holds the lease.

type.title: Grantee type
type.description: What kind of component the grantee is.

action_classes.title: Action classes
action_classes.description: The consequential action classes this grant currently authorizes. Must be a subset of scope.action_classes.

for_whom.title: For whom
for_whom.description: Who the delegation serves: the principal on whose behalf the grantee acts.

evidence_basis.title: Evidence basis
evidence_basis.description: The propositions that justify this authority, as references to policy records or evidence items. When these change materially the grant becomes eligible for reconsideration (Law III).

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Conditions assumed true at issue time. A falsified assumption is grounds for review.

review_conditions.title: Review conditions
review_conditions.description: Conditions under which the grant moves to review_required.

revocation_conditions.title: Revocation conditions
revocation_conditions.description: Conditions under which the grant moves to suspended or revoked.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How much autonomy the delegation carries: the same field STD-07 §2.2 records on an authorization record, with the same values. unattended: the grantee acts without a human in the path. confirm: a named human must confirm each action before it takes effect. forbidden: the delegation is recorded but no action may be taken under it. Mode is not state: mode says how much autonomy the delegation carries when it is in force, state says whether it is in force at all. The two vary independently — a grant may be mode unattended and state suspended. A grant with mode confirm MUST carry intervention_ref (STD-08 §3.2).

state.title: State
state.description: Current lease state: whether the grant is in force right now. Only allowed grants authorize action; review_required means the burden of proof has shifted back to the issuer. State is not mode: state says whether the delegation is in force, mode says how much autonomy it carries while it is. A grant in state allowed with mode confirm is in force but requires human confirmation per action; a grant in state suspended with mode unattended authorizes nothing at all.

state_history.title: State history
state_history.description: Every transition the grant has undergone, including issue, renewal, and expansion. Expansion is recorded as its own transition because success is not the default reward (Law XI).

from.title: From state
from.description: State before the transition. Use none for the issuing transition.

evidence_ref.title: Evidence reference
evidence_ref.description: Identifier of the reconsideration, challenge, incident, or evidence item that caused the transition.

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain-language note on the transition, for example what was narrowed.

until.title: Until
until.description: When the lease lapses: either a date-time or a plain-language condition. Absence of observed failure is not renewal.

oneOf.title: Expiry timestamp
oneOf.description: The grant lapses at this time unless renewed.

oneOf.title: Expiry condition
oneOf.description: The grant lapses when this condition holds.

renewal_basis.title: Renewal basis
renewal_basis.description: What evidence must be produced to renew the lease. The burden rises with duration and consequence (Law II).

policy_refs.title: Policy references
policy_refs.description: The policy records this grant depends on, each pinned to a version (STD-08 §2.2). An unpinned reference is a reference to whatever the policy has since become.

items.title: Pinned policy reference
items.description: One policy record and the version of it this grant rests on.

policy_id.title: Policy identifier
policy_id.description: Stable identifier of the policy record, matching policy_id in policy-record.schema.json.

version.title: Policy version
version.description: The version of that policy record this grant was justified against, matching version in policy-record.schema.json. A later version is a new evidentiary state and does not inherit this grant's justification.

intervention_ref.title: Intervention reference
intervention_ref.description: Identifier of the intervention spec that says who can halt, narrow, or revoke this grant.

capability_catalog_ref.title: Capability catalog reference
capability_catalog_ref.description: Identifier of the capability catalog this grant selects from.

dependency_ref.title: Dependency reference
dependency_ref.description: Identifier of the dependency record for the system holding this grant.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A reachable, accountable person or role.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the person or body.

evidenceRef.title: Evidence reference
evidenceRef.description: A pointer to a policy record or evidence item with its summary and freshness.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Identifier or URL of the policy record or evidence item.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Plain-language summary of what the evidence establishes.

as_of.title: As of
as_of.description: When the evidence was last confirmed.

allOf.title: Confirm mode requires an intervention specification
allOf.description: STD-08 §3.2: every delegation recorded under STD-07 §2.2 with mode confirm must carry intervention_ref pointing at that specification. A confirm mode with no specification behind it is recorded as unattended, because that is how it behaves.
